clip_research.source_claim: The biggest risk with inflation right now is that an inflationary mindset could start to set in, and the US has been missing its inflation objective for more than five and a half years.
clip_research.public_baseline: Fed officials have repeatedly warned about inflation persistence and the importance of keeping long-term inflation expectations anchored; Chinese media coverage in 2025 notes inflation may stay above target until 2027.
clip_research.surprise_gap: Hammack frames the primary risk as a psychological 'inflationary mindset' rather than a specific data point, and cites a five-and-a-half-year miss of the 2% objective, which is a more direct admission of prolonged failure than the usual Fed communication.

evidence.fact: Hammack says the biggest inflation risk is an inflationary mindset setting in and that the US has missed its inflation objective for more than five and a half years.
